description: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc. Captures partnership and partner identity plus the partner's distributive share fields.

tax_year.instruction: Calendar tax year shown on the K-1

partnership_name.instruction: Part I A: name of the partnership

partnership_address.instruction: Part I B: partnership mailing address

partner_ssn_or_ein.instruction: Part II E: partner's identifying number

partner_address.instruction: Part II F: partner's mailing address

partner_type.instruction: Part II G: General/LP, Limited, or LLC member-manager

is_foreign_partner.instruction: Part II H1: whether the partner is a foreign partner

profit_share_begin.instruction: Part II J: profit share percentage at beginning of year

profit_share_end.instruction: Part II J: profit share percentage at end of year

loss_share_end.instruction: Part II J: loss share percentage at end of year

capital_share_end.instruction: Part II J: capital share percentage at end of year

capital_account_beginning.instruction: Part II L: beginning capital account

capital_account_ending.instruction: Part II L: ending capital account

ordinary_business_income.instruction: Part III line 1: ordinary business income (loss)

net_rental_real_estate_income.instruction: Part III line 2: net rental real estate income (loss)

net_short_term_capital_gain.instruction: Part III line 8: net short-term capital gain (loss)

net_long_term_capital_gain.instruction: Part III line 9a: net long-term capital gain (loss)

self_employment_earnings.instruction: Part III line 14: self-employment earnings (loss), code A

distributions.instruction: Part III line 19: distributions, code A
